stem: Assume only the cited RA 11032 receipt and signatory provisions apply. Office K uses one stable application ID but omits receipt date/time. Office L records complete receipt details but waits for an officer on official leave instead of designating an alternate. Which paired repair addresses the distinct gaps?

choices.text: K keeps the receipt incomplete; L designates an alternate
K adds date/time; L designates an alternate
K changes the ID at every step; L adds four signatories
K adds date/time; L waits until the officer returns

explanation: The acknowledgment includes date/time; a stable ID does not replace receipt details. Official leave requires an alternate signatory; complete receipts do not cure that delay.
